profile.headline: Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer working at DataStax, currently working on a project leveraging ReactJS, NodeJS, and Go.

positions.title: Android Developer - Intern
positions.description: Work under the CTO and alongside a team of fellow Android interns to develop FlipWord’s first Android app to accompany the first iOS app and existing web interface. Communicate effectively with the iOS team to ensure a seamless experience for users while both products are developed natively.

positions.title: Camp Counselor/Lifeguard
positions.description: Care for 100-400 campers for a week at a time over a period of 8 weeks during the summer, while also assuming more responsibility for 10-12 each week within a cabin shared with one other counselor. Assist in the coordination of the weekly recreational and educational programs as well as assumed responsibility for campers as a lifeguard during any pool times and from a rescue boat during activities such as sailing, canoeing, and tubing.

positions.title: Computer Engineer - Intern
positions.description: Program, test, and package signal producing boards, magnets, etc. sold by Spincore Technologies. Create solutions for specific client issues alongside the team of engineers and guide customers to implement those solutions.

projects.title: iOS Advisor Application
projects.description:
• Calculates GPA semesterly and advises users in scheduling their academic career to achieve a set graduation GPA
• Allows student to calculate minimum grade combinations in order to achieve specific semester GPA, given credit
hours of each course
• Provides recommended semester plans by referencing the user’s degree audit and course availability
